biotools.summary: NRGSuite-Qt is a PyMOL plugin designed for high-throughput virtual screening, molecular docking, and analysis of molecular interactions. It integrates several tools into a single platform, simplifying complex workflows and improving visualization for macromolecular cavity detection, virtual screening, and normal mode analysis.
